name: com.useholla/holla
title: Holla
description: Singapore vouchers, travel eSIMs, parking rates, EV chargers and Johor checkpoint traffic.

tools.name: search_vouchers
tools.description: Search the Singapore gift cards and vouchers sold on Holla by brand, service or item, for example GrabFood, Shopee or FairPrice. Each result has the voucher's face value and selling price in SGD and a purchaseUrl where the user can check the current price and terms, sign in and pay on Holla. This tool does not buy anything. Results come in pages; nextPage is the page number of the next results, or null on the last page.

query.description: Brand, service or item name, for example "GrabFood".

faceValueSgd.description: Only return vouchers with exactly this face value in SGD, for example 10 for a S$10 voucher.

tools.name: find_esim_plans
tools.description: Find travel eSIM data plans sold on Holla for a country, region or destination code, for example Japan, Europe or JP. For one matching destination it returns up to eight plans with data allowance, validity, activation rules, the price in SGD and a purchaseUrl. If several destinations match, it returns those destinations with their IDs instead of plans.

destination.description: Country, region or destination code, for example "Japan" or "JP".

tools.name: find_parking
tools.description: Find car parks near a Singapore destination with the estimated parking charge in SGD for the given arrival time and length of stay and, where reported, the number of available lots. sort "nearest" lists the closest first; "cheapest" lists the lowest charge first among car parks within walkMinutes of the destination (the result's walkMinutes is wider when none are that close). A null estimate or lot count means it is not known; car parks priced by zone give estimateFromSgd and estimateToSgd instead. If the destination matches several places, the result lists them as choices with their coordinates instead.

destination.description: Singapore place name, address or postal code, for example "Orchard Road" or "238801". Give this or both latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude of a point in Singapore, in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of a point in Singapore, in decimal degrees.

arrival.description: Arrival time in ISO 8601 with a time-zone offset, for example "2026-12-01T19:00:00+08:00". Defaults to now.

durationMinutes.description: Length of stay in minutes. Defaults to 60.

sort.description: Order of the list. Defaults to nearest.

walkMinutes.description: For cheapest: the longest walk to the destination, in minutes. Defaults to 5.

limit.description: How many car parks to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: find_ev_chargers
tools.description: Find EV charging sites near a Singapore destination with each charger's operator, plug type, power in kW, price per kWh in SGD and, where reported, each connector's status: available, in_use or out_of_service. A null status means no recent report. Without car details the result is general. The optional car details describe one car: batteryKwh (usable battery), maxDcKw and maxAcKw (its top charging power), plug (its fast-charging plug, usually ccs2) and tesla. With batteryKwh each site gets a chargeStop: the fastest connector that fits, the time and cost to charge from 20% to 80%, the parking fee for that time and the total. sort "cheapest" orders by that total when batteryKwh is given, else by price per kWh; "nearest" orders by distance. Tesla-only chargers are left out once car details are given, unless tesla is true. If the destination matches several places, the result lists them as choices with their coordinates instead.

destination.description: Singapore place name, address or postal code, for example "Orchard Road" or "238801". Give this or both latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude of a point in Singapore, in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of a point in Singapore, in decimal degrees.

plug.description: Only return chargers with this connector type.

batteryKwh.description: The car's usable battery in kWh, for example 60.5 for a BYD Atto 3.

maxDcKw.description: The car's top DC fast-charging power in kW.

maxAcKw.description: The car's top AC charging power in kW.

tesla.description: True for a Tesla, which may also use Tesla-only chargers.

sort.description: Order of the list. Defaults to nearest.

limit.description: How many sites to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_checkpoint_traffic
tools.description: Get the current estimated driving time and delay in minutes across the Woodlands and Tuas checkpoints between Singapore and Johor Bahru, in either direction. Each route also has its usual time without traffic. fetchedAt is when the times were measured; they change quickly.

direction.description: Only return this direction: Singapore to Johor Bahru, or Johor Bahru to Singapore.
